name: BZ
summary: S. Army code EA-2277; NATO code BZ; Soviet code Substance 78) is an odorless and bitter-tasting, military-grade incapacitating agent. It impairs muscle movement and causes delirium and hallucinations to the point of helplessness.

pharmacology.text: BZ is an muscarinic antagonist, meaning that it blocks muscarinic acetylcholine receptors, on which the brain relies for memory formation, attention and muscle movement.

uses.text: BZ was first synthesized by the Swiss pharmaceutical company Hoffman-LaRoche in 1951, which unsuccessfully tried to develop it into a treatment for gastrointestinal disease. Allegations have been made that the U.S. Army used it in the Vietnam War.

summaryZh: 二苯乙醇酸-3-喹嚀環酯- IUPAC名 1-azabicyclo[2.2.2]oct-3-yl 2-hydroxy-2,2-diphenylacetate；美軍代號：EA-2277；北約代號：BZ(畢茲)；蘇聯代號：Substance 78。是一種無味的軍事失能劑。

sideEffects.en: It blocks acetylcholine and causes severe delirium, confusion, vivid hallucinations, memory loss, wide pupils, blurred vision, a dry mouth, a racing heart and loss of coordination. The confusion can last for days, and overheating is a serious risk.
sideEffects.zh: 它阻斷乙醯膽鹼，造成嚴重譫妄、混亂、鮮明幻覺、記憶喪失、瞳孔放大、視力模糊、口乾、心跳急促與協調喪失。混亂狀態可能持續數日，體溫過高也是嚴重風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它阻断乙酰胆碱，造成严重谵妄、混乱、鲜明幻觉、记忆丧失、瞳孔放大、视力模糊、口干、心跳急促与协调丧失。混乱状态可能持续数日，体温过高也是严重风险。

fact.en: It was first made by Hoffmann-La Roche in 1951 while the company was looking for a treatment for stomach and bowel complaints. Its chemical name is quinuclidinyl benzilate, which is where the abbreviation QNB comes from.
fact.zh: BZ 最早由羅氏公司於 1951 年合成，當時公司正在尋找治療胃腸疾病的藥物。它的化學名稱是 quinuclidinyl benzilate，縮寫 QNB 即由此而來。
fact.zhHans: BZ 最早由罗氏公司于 1951 年合成，当时公司正在寻找治疗胃肠疾病的药物。它的化学名称是 quinuclidinyl benzilate，缩写 QNB 即由此而来。
